notes: PhoneArena's 2025-2026 benchmark cohort supplies a broad cross-brand set of browsing, video and gaming runtime observations.
Runtime observations are stored as observations rather than model coefficients.
The runtime engine normalizes each workload by the tested phone's battery capacity before applying the observed drain envelope to a simulated phone.
Selected earlier GSMArena and Tom's Guide references remain documented elsewhere in the repository for cross-source validation.

unsupported_workloads.camera_use: No isolated, protocol-compatible camera runtime observation is present in this calibration dataset.

notes: Calibration database contains 123 recent released phones across multiple brands and sources.
PhoneArena supplies the broad common-protocol cohort; retained earlier references preserve additional phones and cross-source evidence.
